name: Marina Foodies
about: Where to eat along the Marina and JBR, shared honestly. Shawarma debates, late-night grills and the odd brunch splurge.

stories.text: Brunch on the Marina boardwalk was worth the sunburn. The pancakes are huge.

stories.author: p06
stories.text: Late night grill near JBR, smoke everywhere, zero regrets. Yalla!

stories.author: p08

posts.author: p03
posts.text: Rant of the week: restaurants that drop a service charge onto the bill and then also add a tip line. Please explain, I am genuinely confused and a bit annoyed.

comments.author: p01
comments.text: Yes, always check the bill before tipping. Ask the waiter to explain the line.

comments.author: p04
comments.text: Service charge is usually for the house, tip is for the person. Both can be on the bill.

comments.author: p08
comments.text: I just ask for the breakdown politely. Most staff are happy to show it to you.

comments.author: p06
comments.text: Tipping culture is complicated here, but the staff depend on it, so I tip anyway.

comments.author: p02
comments.text: Read the menu footer, the service charge is written in small print. Lesson learned.

comments.author: p05
comments.text: I once tipped twice by accident. The waiter was very polite about it, lol.

comments.author: p07
comments.text: Honest suggestion: ask for the bill to be split by item so you see every fee.

comments.author: p09
comments.text: Our team lunch got a double charge once. The manager fixed it in minutes.

comments.author: p10
